name: N G Industries LTD
summary: N G Industries LTD provides various healthcare services in India. The company operates a diagnostic center with daycare and nursing home facilities that provides a range of medical services in the fields of pathology, radiology, cardiology, gastroenterology, infertility, minimal invasive surgeries, general surgery, joint replacement, urology, as well as multispecialty clinics and an intensive care unit. It also offers inpatient and outpatient services; and pharmacy dispensing services. N G Industries LTD was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Kolkata, India.
